    Siren - Class in Character_Classes
    Represents the Siren boss enemy encountered on the BossFloor.
    Siren(int, int) - Constructor for class Character_Classes.Siren
    Constructs a Siren boss enemy at the given grid position with fixed combat stats (10.0 attack, 750 gold drop, 1 turn per move, detection range of 100, diagonal movement enabled) and a starting health of 1.0.
    spawnExit() - Method in class Dungeon_Classes.BossFloor
    Spawns the floor's Exit tile ('E') at the Siren's current position, called once the Siren has been defeated.
    spawnSwitchPair() - Method in class Dungeon_Classes.BossFloor
    Randomly places a new pair of switch tiles ('0') within a bounded distance of one another, avoiding the Siren's exclusion zone and any already-occupied tiles.
    startDungeon(Dungeon) - Static method in class Controller.GameGUI
    Enters a dungeon for the first time: resets Yohane's turn counter so turn-interval effects (bat move cadence, the boss fight's every-8-turn bat summon) always start from a clean 0 rather than whatever parity was left over from the previous dungeon; sets the dungeon as current; places Yohane on its first floor; and clears the underlying 'Y' tile so it's not drawn twice.
    startGame() - Method in class View.MainFrame
    Starts a fresh run: resets Controller state, refreshes the game panel's stats and map, then switches to the game card.
    StatusPanel - Class in View
    View panel showing the player's run statistics: how many times each rescuable NPC has been saved, total gold spent, number of game overs, and how many times the Siren has been defeated.
    StatusPanel(MainFrame) - Constructor for class View.StatusPanel
    Constructs the status panel and builds its layout.
    summonBat(int, int, int, int) - Method in class Character_Classes.Siren
    Spawns a Bat with tiered difficulty based on switch triggers, placing it on a randomly chosen empty tile that is not occupied by Lailaps, Yohane, another enemy, or an exclusion zone.
